description: This file contains a Roslyn analyzer class 'AtMostOneOrleansConstructorAnalyzer' that enforces a rule to ensure at most one Orleans constructor in a class or struct, by analyzing syntax nodes and reporting diagnostics.

classes.name: AtMostOneOrleansConstructorAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer class that checks for multiple Orleans constructors in a class or struct.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes a syntax node to determine if it has more than one Orleans constructor and reports a diagnostic if so.
